title: Receipt (CommitReceipt | TurnReceipt | CommandReceipt)
description: Stable idempotency answers. Rust: crates/agentscope-durable/src/types/{commit.rs::CommitReceipt, turn.rs::TurnReceipt, turn.rs::CommandReceipt}. Java: CommitReceipt / TurnReceipt / CommandReceipt. Exactly one shape matches a given document.

CommitReceipt.description: Answer of one applied commit. `receipt(thread, turnId, commitId)` replays it without re-applying the commit.

digest.description: SHA-256 over the RFC 8785 canonical commit, 64 hex characters.

revision.description: Turn revision after this commit (the first commit takes a turn from 0 to 1).

cursor.description: '<session storage key>:<sequence>'. The storage key is 'session:<sha256(namespace)>:<sha256(sessionId)>'.

TurnReceipt.description: Admission answer: the same requestId on the same thread with the same input answers the same turnId.

CommandReceipt.description: Admission answer of a control command (STEER/INJECT/WITHDRAW/CANCEL/RESPOND/PAUSE/RESUME/SIGNAL). Later application is observed through events and state.
